direction: Atelier Nocturno: tecnología editorial de autor

display.use: Editorial headings, italic emphasis, and large product names

body.use: Navigation, body copy, metadata, controls, and forms

typography.provenance: Google Fonts; source URLs and license file names are recorded in sitio/assets/fonts/README.md

portfolio.presentation: Text descriptions and links; no invented claims or product screenshots

layout.mobileBehavior: Editorial grids stack; compact indexed rows remain; navigation toggles with aria-expanded state

components.contact: Preserve native validation, consent, privacy link, configured WhatsApp check, and in-browser message review handoff

accessibility.skipLink: First keyboard stop to main content
accessibility.mobileNavigation: Button label and aria-expanded reflect open state; selecting a link closes it
accessibility.reducedMotion: Reduce scroll, animation, and transition motion when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled

evidence.note: Documentation pass checked source and local capture inventory; no new visual or interaction validation was performed.
